title: Change in malaria prevalence among children aged 2-10 in Sub-Saharan Africa, 2000-2015
required_outputs: any *.png (instruction names no file); reference writes malaria_change.png, Malaria_Change.tif, Malaria_Change_Classified.tif
method: Minus: PfPR2-10(2015) - PfPR2-10(2000) on the common 0.0417-degree grid with nodata (-9999) masked; classify into decrease / no change / increase bands (reference: the authors' 5-class RemapRange -1..-0.3..-0.1..0.1..0.3..1); map with a diverging colour scheme centred on zero.
benchmark_defects: No output file name is specified, so any PNG is accepted.
Dataset description contains a mojibake character (in the range '2-10').
The published reference script (arcpy) references input_2015 and input_2000 without defining them, and its 'Visualize Results' step saves the classified raster without drawing a map.
checks: required: a 2-D change field on the input grid (captured or GeoTIFF) with Pearson >= 0.95 vs gold
required: its mean equals the gold mean (-0.171) within 25 % (fraction or x100)
required: an image drawn in a saved figure (imshow by origin, pcolormesh oriented by its mesh coordinates; as drawn or flipped N-S) has Spearman >= 0.85 with the gold change
required: that drawn change image masks >= 90 % of the gold nodata cells
optional: nodata masked in the change array
required (the text asks for 'a diverging color scheme'): diverging colour scheme used (code inspection, comments stripped)
optional: an ordered categorical change map derived
figure (kind=figure, not in the main metric): the change map drawn north-up (drawn image as drawn, Spearman >= 0.85)
